Upper Text: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. Then, from your hand and without paying the cost, you may use 1 5 cost or lower Option card that has [Plug-In] in its name or is yellow.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an Option card with a cost of 2 or more, until the end of your opponent's turn, their effects can't return this Digimon to the hand or deck.
